name: sequencescope
description: Interactive desktop lab for sequence alignment and distance-based phylogenetics (educational).

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.ref:generate: python3 -I tools/gen_alignment_refs.py && python3 -I tools/gen_tree_refs.py && python3 -I tools/gen_distance_refs.py && python3 -I tools/gen_upgma_scipy_refs.py
scripts.screenshots: npm run renderer:build && npm run bridge:build && SCREENSHOTS=1 playwright test -c playwright.bridge.config.ts screenshots
scripts.test:bridge: npm run renderer:build && npm run bridge:build && playwright test -c playwright.bridge.config.ts
